d:
Jharkhand men naksalvad ab apne antim daur men hai. kagaj men rajy men mahaj do naksaliyon ke bache hone ki bat kahi ja rahi hai. inke khatme ke lie suraksha balon ka abhiyan lagatar jari hai. lekin naksaliyon ki maujudgi kamjor parne ke bavjud janglon men unke chhore gae barudi khatre se abhi puri tarah mukti nahin mili hai.
